<launch>
    <!-- start arduino mega board-->
    <node pkg="rosserial_python" name="chassis_node" type="serial_node.py" args="/dev/chassis" respawn="true"/>
    
    <!-- open joy control -->
    <node pkg="joy" type="joy_node" name="joy_node" >
        <param name="dev" value="/dev/input/js0" />
        <param name="autorepeat_rate" value="20.0" />
        <param name="deadzone" value="0.05" />
    </node>

    <!-- open joy velocity publisher -->
    <node pkg="teleop_twist_joy" type="teleop_node" name="teleop_node">
        <rosparam command="load" file="/home/tjark/ugv_sdk/config/joy/joy.yaml" />
        <remap from="cmd_vel" to="joy_vel"/>
    </node>
    <include file="$(find joystick_filter)/joystick_filter.launch"/>

    <!-- open cmd_vel publisher -->
    <node pkg="twist_mux" type="twist_mux" name="cmd_twist_mux" output="screen">
        <remap from="cmd_vel_out" to="/cmd_vel"/>                          
        <rosparam file="/home/tjark/ugv_sdk/config/joy/twist_mux_locks.yaml"  command="load"/>
        <rosparam file="/home/tjark/ugv_sdk/config/joy/twist_mux_topics.yaml" command="load"/>
    </node> 
    <include file="$(find vel_filters)/vel_filter.launch" />

    <!-- chassis_init_param-->
    <node pkg="chassis_init_param" type="chassis_init_param_node" name="chassis_init_param_node" output="screen"/>

    <!-- ultrasound_check-->
    <node pkg="ultrasound_check" type="ultrasound_check_node" name="ultrasound_check_node" output="screen"/>

    <!-- open odom  -->
    <include file="$(find chassis_odom)/launch/chassis_odom.launch"/>

    <!-- status system  -->
    <node pkg="status_system" type="status_system_node" name="status_system_node" output="screen" />

    <!-- open the laser  -->
    <!-- <include file="$(find rplidar_ros)/launch/rplidar.launch" /> -->
    <!-- <include file="$(find pepperl_fuchs_r2000)/launch/r2000.launch" /> -->
    <include file="$(find ltme_node)/launch/ltme02a.launch"/>
    <!-- <include file="$(find sick_tim)/launch/sick_tim551_2050001.launch"/>  -->

    <!-- handle laser data -->
    <node pkg="convertscanpose" type="convertscanpose_node" name="convertscanpose_node" output="screen" />
    <include file="$(find laser_filters)/launch/laser_filter.launch"/>
    <include file="$(find checklidar)/launch/checklidar.launch"/>

    <!-- open the imu  -->
    <!-- <include file="$(find yesense_imu)/launch/yesense.launch"/> -->

    <!-- ekf using imu and odometry   -->
    <include file="$(find robot_localization)/launch/ekf_DreamBuilder.launch"/>

    <!-- ros3djs setup   -->
    <include file="/home/tjark/ugv_sdk/launch/ros3djs.launch"/>

    <!-- agv_plan setup   -->
    <include file="$(find agv_plan)/launch/agv_plan.launch"/>

    <!-- virtual_wall setup   -->
    <include file="$(find virtual_wall)/launch/virtual_wall.launch"/>

    <!-- move_base setup   -->
    <include file="/home/tjark/ugv_sdk/launch/move_base.launch"/>

    <!-- transform set up. -->
    <node pkg="tf" type="static_transform_publisher" name="base_to_imu" args="0.1815 0 0 0 0 0 base_link imu 20" />
    <node pkg="tf" type="static_transform_publisher" name="base_to_laser" args="0.1855 0 0 0 0 0 base_link laser 20" />

    <!-- open auto-charge -->
    <include file="$(find docking_system)/launch/docking_charger.launch"/>

    <!-- start UWB tracking -->
    <include file="$(find serial_port)/serial_port.launch"/>
</launch>

reference_files./home/tjark/ugv_sdk/src/new_move_base/pa: new_move_base 1.14.3 The move_base package provides an implementation of an action (see the actionlib package) that, given a goal in the world, will attempt to reach it with a mobile base. The move_base node links together a global and local planner to accomplish its global navigation task. It supports any global planner adhering to the nav_core::BaseGlobalPlanner interface specified in the nav_core package and any local planner adhering to the nav_core::BaseLocalPlanner interface specified in the nav_core package. The move_base node also maintains two costmaps, one for the global planner, and one for a local planner (see the costmap_2d package) that are used to accomplish navigation tasks.
